question: The profit obtained by selling an article for ₹1,850 is twice the profit obtained by selling the article for ₹1,600. The cost price of the article is:
solution:
**Given:**

The profit obtained by selling an article for Rs 1,850 is twice the profit obtained by selling the article for Rs 1,600

**Formula used:**

Selling price - cost price = profit

**Calculation:**

Let the cost price be x

According to the question,

1850 - x = 2 (1600 - x)

⇒ 1850 - x = 3200 - 2x

⇒ 2x - x = 3200 - 1850

⇒ x = 1350

**∴ Cost price of the article is Rs. 1350**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__**We can solve this question by the option elimination method.

If we take Rs 1350 as cp, 

The profit in 1st case will be 1850 - 1350 = Rs 500

The profit in 2nd case will be 1600 - 1350 = Rs 250

The profit in the 1st case is double from the 2nd case. 

So, the condition is satisfied.

**∴ The cost**** **price of the article is Rs 1350.
